modules.source:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Board Explorer: the board's connector on the screen (its description says which: the Arduino one
# of the STM32MP157C-DK2, the 40-pin header of the STM32MP135F-DK). Tap a pin, choose what it does,
# see its value live. GPIO pins are Linux GPIO lines (machine.Pin). ADC, PWM and I2C are served by
# the Cortex-M4 where there is one, which also reads back the level an output really has and
# measures the PWM on its pin; by Linux's drivers on a board without one.

import time

import lvgl as lv

import board

COLORS = {
    "off": 0x2A3444, "in": 0x2F6FDE, "out": 0xE0742F, "adc": 0x2E9E6A, "pwm": 0x8A5CF6,
    "bus": 0x2B8A9E,
}
MODES = {
    "gpio": ["Off", "In", "In+", "Out"],
    "pwm": ["Off", "PWM"],
    "adc": ["ADC"],
    "i2c": ["Scan"],
    "spi": [],
    "uart": [],
}
FREQUENCIES = [50, 1000, 20000]

_ui = None
_buttons = {}   # name -> (button, label)
_state = {}     # name -> mode text ("Off", "In", "In+", "Out", "ADC", "PWM", "Scan")
_selected = None
_map = None     # the button matrix's map, kept alive
_pwm = [1000, 25]
_out = {}       # name -> 0 or 1, what an output is set to
_measured = None
_measured_at = 0
_scan = None
_ticks = 0
_error = None   # what went wrong in the last action, shown until the next one


def _pin(name):
    for entry in board.PINS:
        if entry[0] == name:
            return entry
    return None


def _title(name):
    return name[:1].upper() + name[1:]


def _small():
    return lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution() < 400


def _font(size):
    return getattr(lv, "font_montserrat_%d" % size)


def _hide(obj, hidden):
    if hidden:
        obj.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    else:
        obj.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)


def _color(name):
    kind = _pin(name)[2]
    mode = _state.get(name, "Off")
    if kind in ("i2c", "spi", "uart"):
        return COLORS["bus"]
    if kind == "adc":
        return COLORS["adc"]
    if mode == "PWM":
        return COLORS["pwm"]
    if mode == "Out":
        return COLORS["out"]
    if mode in ("In", "In+"):
        return COLORS["in"]
    return COLORS["off"]


def _caption(name):
    kind = _pin(name)[2]
    mode = _state.get(name, "Off")
    if kind in ("i2c", "spi", "uart"):
        return kind.upper()
    if kind == "adc":
        return _state.get(name + ":v", "")
    if mode == "PWM":
        return "%d%%" % _pwm[1]
    if mode == "Out":
        return "H" if _out.get(name) else "L"
    if mode in ("In", "In+"):
        return _state.get(name + ":v", "")
    return "-"


def _paint(name):
    button, label = _buttons[name]
    button.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(_color(name)), 0)
    button.set_style_border_width(3 if name == _selected else 0, 0)
    label.set_text("%s\n%s" % (name, _caption(name)))


def _place(index, name, panel):
    # (x, y, width, height) of a pin's button: the Arduino rows (digital, then analog) on the
    # STM32MP157C-DK2's screen, else a grid that fills the panel.
    if board.ARDUINO and not _small():
        if name.startswith("D"):
            return 7 + (index % 8) * 57, 28 + (index // 8) * 80, 52, 70
        return 7 + (index - 16) * 57, 218, 52, 70
    panel.update_layout()
    width, height = panel.get_content_width(), panel.get_content_height()
    count = len(board.PINS)
    columns = 7 if _small() else (8 if count > 22 else 6)
    rows = (count + columns - 1) // columns
    w, h = width // columns, height // rows
    return (index % columns) * w + 1, (index // columns) * h + 1, w - 4, h - 4


def _build_pins(panel):
    if _small():
        panel.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    if board.ARDUINO and not _small():
        for text, y in (("DIGITAL", 6), ("ANALOG", 196)):
            caption = lv.label(panel)
            caption.set_text(text)
            caption.set_pos(10, y)
            caption.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0x8FA0B5), 0)
            caption.set_style_text_font(_font(14), 0)
    for index, (name, mcu, kind, bus) in enumerate(board.PINS):
        x, y, w, h = _place(index, name, panel)
        button = lv.button(panel)
        button.set_pos(x, y)
        button.set_size(w, h)
        button.set_style_pad_all(0, 0)
        button.set_style_radius(6 if _small() else 10, 0)
        button.set_style_border_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF), 0)
        button.set_style_shadow_width(0, 0)
        label = lv.label(button)
        label.set_style_text_font(_font(14 if _small() else 16), 0)
        label.set_style_text_align(lv.TEXT_ALIGN.CENTER, 0)
        label.center()
        button.add_event_cb(lambda e, n=name: select(n), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
        _buttons[name] = (button, label)
        if kind == "adc":
            _state[name] = "ADC"


def _set_modes(name):
    global _map
    modes = MODES[_pin(name)[2]]
    matrix = _ui.mode_buttons
    _hide(matrix, not modes)
    if not modes:
        return
    _map = modes + [""]
    matrix.set_map(_map)
    matrix.set_button_ctrl_all(lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKABLE)
    matrix.set_one_checked(True)
    current = _state.get(name, modes[0])
    if current in modes:
        matrix.set_button_ctrl(modes.index(current), lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKED)


def _show_controls(name):
    kind = _pin(name)[2]
    mode = _state.get(name, "Off")
    _hide(_ui.value_bar, kind != "adc")
    _hide(_ui.duty_slider, mode != "PWM")
    _hide(_ui.freq_buttons, mode != "PWM")
    _hide(_ui.out_switch, mode != "Out")
    if mode == "PWM":
        _ui.duty_slider.set_value(_pwm[1], False)
        _ui.freq_buttons.set_button_ctrl_all(lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKABLE)
        _ui.freq_buttons.set_one_checked(True)
        _ui.freq_buttons.set_button_ctrl(FREQUENCIES.index(_pwm[0]), lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKED)
    if mode == "Out":
        if _out.get(name):
            _ui.out_switch.add_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
        else:
            _ui.out_switch.remove_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)


def select(name):
    global _selected, _measured, _error
    previous, _selected = _selected, name
    _measured = None
    _error = None
    if previous:
        _paint(previous)
    _paint(name)
    entry = _pin(name)
    _ui.pin_title.set_text("%s%s  -  %s" % ("pin " if name.isdigit() else "", name, entry[1]))
    _ui.pin_info.set_text(board.describe(name, _small()))
    _set_modes(name)
    _show_controls(name)
    _ui.value_note.set_text("")
    refresh()


def _apply(name, mode):
    # Set the hardware for a new mode of a pin.
    label, mcu, kind, bus = _pin(name)
    hw = board.hardware
    try:
        if mode in ("In", "In+"):
            hw.pin_in(mcu, mode == "In+")
        elif mode == "Out":
            hw.pin_out(mcu, _out.get(name, 0))
        elif mode == "PWM":
            hw.pwm(mcu, _pwm[0], _pwm[1])
        elif mode == "Scan":
            global _scan
            _scan = hw.scan(bus)
        elif mode == "Off":
            hw.release(mcu)
        _state[name] = mode
    except OSError as error:
        global _error
        _error = "Error: %s" % error


def mode_changed(matrix):
    global _error
    if not _selected:
        return
    _error = None
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    modes = MODES[_pin(_selected)[2]]
    if 0 <= index < len(modes):
        _apply(_selected, modes[index])
        _show_controls(_selected)
        _paint(_selected)
        refresh()


def out_changed(switch):
    if _selected and _state.get(_selected) == "Out":
        _out[_selected] = 1 if switch.has_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED) else 0
        _apply(_selected, "Out")
        _paint(_selected)
        refresh()


def duty_changed(slider):
    global _measured
    _pwm[1] = slider.get_value()
    _measured = None
    for name in _pwm_pins():
        _apply(name, "PWM")
        _paint(name)


def _pwm_pins():
    return [name for name, mcu, kind, bus in board.PINS if _state.get(name) == "PWM"]


def freq_changed(matrix):
    global _measured
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    if 0 <= index < len(FREQUENCIES):
        _pwm[0] = FREQUENCIES[index]
        _measured = None
        for name in _pwm_pins():
            _apply(name, "PWM")


def led_changed(name, switch):
    global _error
    _error = None
    try:
        board.hardware.led(name, switch.has_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED))
    except OSError as error:
        _error = "%s LED: %s" % (_title(board.hardware.leds[name].name), error)
        refresh()


def refresh():
    # The selected pin's value, in words.
    global _measured, _measured_at
    if not _selected:
        return
    name, mcu, kind, bus = _pin(_selected)
    mode = _state.get(_selected, "Off")
    hw = board.hardware
    value, note = "-", ""
    try:
        if kind == "adc":
            uv = hw.adc_uv(mcu)
            value = "%.3f V" % (uv / 1000000)
            _ui.value_bar.set_value(min(1000, uv * 1000 // board.RANGE_UV), False)
            note = ("Floating: it drifts." if _small() else "Floating while nothing is wired: it drifts.") if uv < 300000 else ""
        elif mode in ("In", "In+"):
            value = "%d" % hw.pin_value(mcu)
            note = "Read by Linux. Pull-up on." if mode == "In+" else "Read by Linux."
        elif mode == "Out":
            set_to = _out.get(_selected, 0)
            seen = hw.seen_by_m4(mcu)
            value = "%s" % ("HIGH" if set_to else "LOW")
            note = "Set by Linux." if seen is None else "Set by Linux; the Cortex-M4 reads %d on the pin." % seen
        elif mode == "PWM":
            now = time.ticks_ms()
            if _measured is None or time.ticks_diff(now, _measured_at) > 1000:
                _measured = hw.measure(mcu, _pwm[0])
                _measured_at = now
            value = "%d Hz  %d%%" % (_pwm[0], _pwm[1])
            if _measured is None:
                note = "Linux's PWM driver; nothing here to measure it." if _small() else \
                    "Set by Linux's PWM driver: no microcontroller here to measure it."
            else:
                frequency, high = _measured
                note = "Measured on the pin by the M4: %.1f Hz, %.1f%%" % (frequency, high * 100)
        elif mode == "Scan":
            found = _scan or []
            value = "%d device%s" % (len(found), "" if len(found) == 1 else "s")
            note = " ".join("0x%02X" % a for a in found) if found else "Nothing answers on I2C%s." % bus
        elif kind in ("spi", "uart"):
            value = kind.upper()
            note = "Used through machine.%s(%s): see the docs." % (kind.upper(), bus)
        else:
            note = "Choose In, In+ or Out."
    except OSError as error:
        note = "Error: %s" % error
    _ui.value.set_text(value)
    # An error of the last action stays until the next one.
    _ui.value_note.set_text(_error or note)


def tick():
    # Every 200 ms: the selected pin; every second the inputs and ADCs of the whole connector.
    global _ticks
    _ticks += 1
    refresh()
    if _ticks % 5:
        return
    hw = board.hardware
    for name, mcu, kind, bus in board.PINS:
        mode = _state.get(name)
        try:
            if kind == "adc":
                _state[name + ":v"] = "%.2f" % (hw.adc_uv(mcu) / 1000000)
            elif mode in ("In", "In+"):
                _state[name + ":v"] = "%d" % hw.pin_value(mcu)
            else:
                continue
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            _state[name + ":v"] = "?"
        _paint(name)


def _style_matrix(matrix, accent):
    # Separate rounded keys on the dark panel; the chosen one in the accent colour.
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.TRANSP, 0)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    matrix.set_style_outline_width(0, lv.STATE.FOCUS_KEY)
    matrix.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    matrix.set_style_pad_gap(6, 0)
    items = lv.PART.ITEMS
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, items)
    matrix.set_style_radius(8, items)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_shadow_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF), items)
    matrix.set_style_text_font(_font(16), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(accent), items | lv.STATE.CHECKED)


def start(ui):
    global _ui
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    if _small():
        board.simulate_small()
    _style_matrix(ui.mode_buttons, 0x2F6FDE)
    _style_matrix(ui.freq_buttons, COLORS["pwm"])
    ui.subtitle.set_text(board.firmware().split(":")[0] if _small() else board.firmware())
    _build_pins(ui.pins_panel)
    for name in _buttons:
        _paint(name)
    for slot in board.LED_SLOTS:
        label, switch = getattr(ui, "led_%s_label" % slot, None), getattr(ui, "led_%s" % slot, None)
        if label is None:
            continue
        led = board.hardware.leds.get(slot)
        if led is None:  # the board has fewer LEDs
            _hide(label, True)
            _hide(switch, True)
            continue
        where = led.spec.get("where", "")
        if _small():
            label.set_text("%s %s" % (_title(led.name), where))
        else:
            label.set_text("%s LED%s\n%s" % (_title(led.name), ", " + where if where else "", led.how()))
    gpio = [name for name, mcu, kind, bus in board.PINS if kind == "gpio"]
    select(gpio[0] if gpio else board.PINS[0][0])
